title: Chegg
description: it takes two to share, and you can share as many as you want
body:

# about the pack

, choose to spawn as one of the food-pairs, gather ingredients, find a partner, and enjoy your food date : )

_, dont forget to download the resourcepack_

![Chegg Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/260da8b10774b39e7f75c22f84e9961c53e23881_0.webp)

![Chegg GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/183732858e296249a1ab195aa8ae15c55fbac9b9.png)

![Additional Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53dd77347171c5424df40bf8a33f68ff449f5d46_0.webp)

# notes
, vanity can be worn by anyone, provided by 'Sunn Egg' origin

, foodstuffs are retextured vanilla food with adjusted hunger/saturation values and bonus effect/s

, all origins can be used by multiple people, no limits !

![Chegg Drawing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c10dd5623eb542c45da252d4bb871c752f95f78.png)
